jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We're building the future of developer tooling. As a Staff Software Engineer, you'll lead technical strategy and mentor a team of engineers.

Responsibilities

  • Architect and implement core platform features
  • Drive technical roadmap and strategy
  • Mentor senior and mid-level engineers

Requirements

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience
  • Track record of leading technical initiatives
  • Experience with distributed systems at scale
  • Python, Go, or Rust expertise

Nice to Have

  • Open source contributions
  • Experience at a high-growth startup

jobs.title: Senior Frontend Engineer (React)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Join our product team as a Senior Frontend Engineer. You'll build the interfaces that millions of users interact with daily.

Requirements

  • 5+ years frontend engineering
  • Expert-level React and TypeScript
  • Experience with performance optimization
  • Strong CSS and accessibility knowledge

jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We're looking for an SRE to keep our systems reliable, scalable, and fast.

Requirements

  • 4+ years SRE or DevOps experience
  • Kubernetes and container orchestration
  • Prometheus, Grafana, or similar observability tools
  • On-call experience

Nice to Have

  • Terraform or Pulumi
  • Multi-region deployment experience
